status: MEASURED, 1D-LTE, NOT PROMOTED — reported for Ryan's adjudication
method: EW -> 1D-LTE via MOOG on repo-owned line regions (RYA-708) built from a NIST ASD pull
arm: Kitt Peak Flux Atlas (lm0780, lm0876), local continuum from the 95th percentile of clean side-bands, +/-0.35 A integration
the_first_pass_was_flattered: the earlier 0.032 dex spread used INTEGRATED ABSORPTION for 8772/8773, which overstated their EWs by 8.7% and 5.8%. Correcting them moved that pair from above the 783 pair to below it. The tighter number was an artifact of the upper bounds and is superseded, not preferred.
residual_is_structured: the disagreement is BY WAVELENGTH REGION, not scatter: within-pair 0.001 and 0.028 dex, between-pair 0.061. The 877 pair is the more saturated one (REW -5.03/-4.95 vs -5.22/-5.11), and the two things that dominate a saturated line are the two we have not derived — DAMPING (our regions inherit turbospectrum_fdamp 2.500 from the Al 6696 template, never derived for a 3d-5f or 3d-6f transition) and MICROTURBULENCE. The residual bites hardest exactly where it should if that is the cause.
caveats: 1D-LTE ONLY. No NLTE grid covers any IR Al line and building one is future work (Ryan 2026-08-09: 'There is no grids...yet'). No correction assumed or applied.
damping inherited, not derived — the least-defended number in the chain, and the likeliest cause of the 0.061 dex inter-region offset
single instrument for the abundance (Kitt Peak). IAG corroborates the DEPTHS to 1-2% but no IAG abundance was computed, so this is not yet a two-instrument value.
comparison_to_the_optical_pair: 6696.023 / 6698.673 gave 6.601 and 6.262, spread 0.339 dex, on C+ gf. The IR set spreads 0.075 on B/B+ gf across two regions. Four times tighter and two grade-tiers better sourced.
decision_for_ryan: report all four (6.415 +/- 0.037, keeps the cross-region check) or the 783 pair alone (6.446, unsaturated and damping-insensitive but one region). I would not pick the 783 pair on its agreement alone — that is choosing the answer that looks best, and the cross-region disagreement is information worth carrying.
